name: PolySwarm (multi-engine threat detection marketplace API)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy, API documentation and a business offering (A8 trusted): 'Registry tiers: Recorded Future, OPSWAT and PolySwarm trusted; MalShare and VirusShare community.' (P177 cond 6).

reliability.justification: Assertions of several marketplace engines combined into a PolyScore; V3LUM reads one PolySwarm vote per hash (P177 cond 5), PolySwarm defines no verdict threshold.

error_markers.reason: PolySwarm: error envelope inside an HTTP 200 answer (could not verify)

polyswarm.description: PolySwarm API key (Authorization header, bare key)
polyswarm.plan_hint: community (free) accounts get 60 calls per hour plus monthly feature quotas; terms 'unknown' until legal records them (P177 cond 4), so the source stays disabled in every profile

hash_search.title: PolySwarm v3 hash search (/v3/search/hash/{md5|sha1|sha256}, metadata only)

terms.quote: Classes: triage free 'noncommercial' (commercial licence 'license'); metadefender free 'noncommercial' (paid plan 'key-terms'); malshare, polyswarm and virusshare 'unknown' until legal records their terms.

hash_search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P177 cond 4). Research C0417 (verified_needs_key, 401). GET https://api.polyswarm.network/v3/search/hash/{type}?hash={hash}&community=default with the bare key in the Authorization header; 'community' is required by the v3 REST docs (missing from the research endpoint). Never built: downloads (/v3/consumer/download/..., /v3/instance/download), submissions (POST/PUT /v3/instance), rescans, sandbox tasks, bundles, reports and IOC endpoints (P177 cond 2). 404 = hash unknown; 400 AMBIGUOUS_HASH = not applicable; the error envelope {status: error} inside HTTP 200 is an error (marker polyswarm_error_envelope). Rate limits: 'community users have 60 calls per hour' (docs, checked 2026-11-26). Batch p3-G07-2, module polyswarm.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G07-2 (P177, module polyswarm). Terms 'unknown': disabled in every profile until legal records them; default_enabled False.
